name: PicoLimbo VPP E2E
author: vpp-e2e@pluginz.dev
description: Lightweight Rust Minecraft backend (PicoLimbo) preconfigured with Velocity Modern Forwarding and whitelist.json for automated VelocityPteroPower E2E testing.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
apk add --no-cache curl jq

UNAME_M="$(uname -m)"
case "$UNAME_M" in
  x86_64)  ARCH='x86_64' ;;
  aarch64) ARCH='aarch64' ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported arch: $UNAME_M" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

GITHUB_PACKAGE="Quozul/PicoLimbo"
PATTERN="pico_limbo_linux-${ARCH}-musl[.]tar[.]gz"

ALL_JSON="$(curl -fsSL "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_PACKAGE}/releases")"
LATEST_JSON="$(printf '%s\n' "$ALL_JSON" | jq 'map(select(.prerelease==false)) | sort_by(.published_at) | reverse | .[0]')"
TAG_NAME="$(printf '%s\n' "$LATEST_JSON" | jq -r '.tag_name')"
DOWNLOAD_URL="$(printf '%s\n' "$LATEST_JSON" | jq -r --arg pat "$PATTERN" '.assets[].browser_download_url | select(test($pat))' | head -n1)"

if [ -z "$DOWNLOAD_URL" ]; then
  echo "Failed to resolve PicoLimbo download URL for arch=$ARCH" >&2
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

ARCHIVE="${DOWNLOAD_URL##*/}"
echo "Downloading PicoLimbo ${TAG_NAME} (${ARCHIVE})..."
curl -fsSL -o "$ARCHIVE" "$DOWNLOAD_URL"
tar -xzf "$ARCHIVE"
rm -f "$ARCHIVE"
chmod +x pico_limbo
printf '%s\n' "$TAG_NAME" > picolimbo-version.txt

FORWARDING_SECRET="${VELOCITY_SECRET:-vpp-e2e-forwarding-secret}"
cat > server.toml <<EOF
bind = "0.0.0.0:25565"

[forwarding]
method = "MODERN"
secret = "${FORWARDING_SECRET}"
EOF

cat > start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
sed -i "s|^bind = .*|bind = \"0.0.0.0:${SERVER_PORT:-25565}\"|" server.toml
exec ./pico_limbo
EOF
chmod +x start.sh

cat > whitelist.json <<'EOF'
[
  {
    "uuid": "00000000-0000-3000-8000-000000000001",
    "name": "Alice"
  },
  {
    "uuid": "00000000-0000-3000-8000-000000000002",
    "name": "Bob"
  },
  {
    "uuid": "00000000-0000-3000-8000-000000000003",
    "name": "Admin"
  }
]
EOF

echo "Installed PicoLimbo ${TAG_NAME} with Velocity Modern Forwarding + whitelist.json"
